activity.notes: Tacitus explicitly identifies Zorsines as king of the Siraces during the Bosporan conflict conventionally dated to 49 CE. No secure accession or end-of-reign dates are available. ATLAS therefore records only the securely attested 49 CE political-military activity, with role King, rather than inventing a full reign span or using the overly broad label Sarmatians.

sources.title: Tacitus, Annals, Book XII
sources.citation_text: Tacitus calls Zorsines king of the Siraci and describes his participation and submission during the Bosporan conflict in the events of 49 CE.
